steps.prompt_exact: Build me a polished self-contained HTML board for checking an SEO article outline: I want to paste a title, meta description, H2s, FAQ, proof points, and CTA, then see simple pass/fix coverage scores with editable sample rows plus copy/export controls.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT produced a self-contained offline HTML board for SEO article outline coverage scoring with inputs for title, meta, H2s, FAQ, proof points, CTA, editable sample rows, readiness checks, copy brief, TXT download, and JSON export.
